Group arrivals, festival rush, bulk bookings in Hindi or English — log everything by WhatsApp message. No register, no spreadsheet.

Built for how dharmshalas actually work

Group & bulk bookings

Log a group of 20 pilgrims in one message — name, room type, dates, advance. No separate entries per person.

Hindi-friendly natural language

Type as you speak — Hindi, English, or mixed. The AI understands context and extracts booking details correctly.

Festival-season campaigns

Send a WhatsApp broadcast to previous guests ahead of Holi, Diwali, or Janmashtami. Personalised, tracked, and ₹1/message.

Monthly P&L reports

On the 1st of each month, get a full P&L on WhatsApp — total revenue, expenses by category, and net surplus. Auto-sent.

Google review funnel

After checkout, Chakrio sends a polite message asking guests to leave a review. No manual follow-up required.

Expense tracking for all costs

Log maintenance costs, prasad expenses, and repair bills in one WhatsApp message. Categorised automatically in your monthly P&L.

Questions from dharmshala managers

Is Chakrio designed for dharmshalas specifically?+

Yes. Our first client is Raghuleela Dham in Goverdhan — a 60-room dharmshala that used to manage everything in a physical register. Chakrio handles high-volume group bookings, festival rushes, and bulk arrivals in plain Hindi or English messages.

Can we log group bookings for 10–20 pilgrims at once?+

Yes. You can send a single message like "Sharma group, 15 people, 3 nights from Purnima" and Chakrio logs it as one booking. Each booking holds arrival dates, group size, room, advance, and balance.

Does it work in Hindi?+

The AI understands natural language — if your team types in Hindi or a mix of Hindi and English, Chakrio parses it correctly. No need to switch to English or fill in fields.

Can I track prasad and maintenance expenses?+

Yes. Type any expense in WhatsApp — prasad, maintenance, repairs — and Chakrio records it instantly. Your monthly P&L report breaks it down by category.
